column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Isaac asks Mia for the Tideglass Blade.

column3: Mia, that blade ends things\nquickly, doesn't it?\nWithout any pain?{end_wait}
It does. You're asking me\nto hand you a mercy, Isaac.{page_break}Think about what that\nmakes you.{end_wait}
The harbor was slower. I'd\nrather it be me than the\nwater, so give it to me.{end_wait}
You fool. The voice inside\nit loves this. It hums when\nsomeone is about to die.{end_wait}
It speaks when I'm angry\nor afraid, and I can't make\nit stop.{end_wait}

Then choose. Take the blade
and its voice, or leave it
with me.{page_break}Will you take the
Tideglass Blade?{end_now}
Then take it. Be quick\nabout it, and be kind,\nbecause the voice won't be.{end_wait}
You'll leave it with me.\nThen don't ask me to be\nmerciful when it sings.{end_wait}
